name: ghoomyaar
description: GhoomYaar - All India tourism discovery and trip planning

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @ghoomyaar/api" "npm run dev -w @ghoomyaar/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @ghoomyaar/api && npm run build -w @ghoomyaar/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @ghoomyaar/api && npm run typecheck -w @ghoomyaar/web
